candidate_review: Compared six public SOULI samples and five stored level examples. Selected the lavender display-level-5 design as lead, coral public sample 6 as companion, and level-1 gold cluster as small accent.

website_reference.observed: Read the user's Chrome tab and sampled the banner. DOM reports a muted looping hero video of 7.333333 seconds. Observed large cast silhouettes and quieter environmental background.
website_reference.used_for: Character prominence and short homepage-loop direction; no third-party artwork was used as an image-generation input.

review: Much larger bright lavender/coral characters contrast with a quieter deep-blue background. Dimensional pixel edges and lighting are a proposed brand-film treatment. The generated face and silhouette details are interpreted, not pixel-identical to the SVG source. The gold cluster reads as a floating accent rather than a clearly separate foreground character. This is a direction preview, not final exact-art production material.
recommended_hero_motion: 7-8 second restrained loop: slight hovering, subtle light and sparks, a steady camera, and a matching start/end composition. Confirm final character artwork before video generation.
